scope: Rally/contact/attempt ledger, reviewed shot and point analysis, score engine, experimental proposals, local development classifier, evaluation and .NET contract

actual_recording.meaning: No event annotations accepted; not an assertion of no actual shots or points
actual_recording.automatic_contacts: unavailable because the current player/shuttle review eligibility is not ready

implemented: Editable native-frame rally/contact/attempt timeline with undo/redo and source-bound drafts
Separate contact, shot, point, terminal and finish review statuses
Winner/error/preceding-pressure linkage and per-rally explanation table
Player contributions, explicit denominators, unknown responsibility and clip playlists
Custom target/margin/cap/best-of score arithmetic; unknown gaps, lets, replays, administrative points and game/match ending checks
Explicit skill-context rubric for forced/unforced acceptance; no heuristic forcedness assignment
Five-observation contact cues with gap/scene/segment/review isolation
Versioned local feature export/combine/softmax training, disjoint sources, abstention and development-only predictions
One-to-one contact evaluation, unknown-aware class/point metrics, pressure links and agreement/kappa
Separate .NET 2.0.0 snapshot reader; old 1.0.0 meanings preserved
Launcher actions for review/apply and optional model/outcome suggestions

verification.synthetic_example: Invented annotated serve/net/smash/block on generated color video produces A=1, B block terminal error, A smash pressure shot, no direct-winner double credit. This is not sports accuracy evidence.
verification.model_training_tests: Synthetic numerical separability/determinism, data splits, duplicate physical contacts, malformed/nonfinite inputs, manifest integrity and abstention; no actual academy model accuracy measured

remaining: Reviewed multi-session academy contacts/shot labels and independent coach rubric agreement
Reliable automatic identity/hitter/contact/class and terminal-event accuracy
Camera/ground-contact-dependent maps, physical movement and flight speed
Official rules profiles, service sequence and scoreboard OCR validation
Real browser/desktop acceptance and held-out pilot sessions
release_status: development_workflow; no automatic accuracy, coaching or full-plan completion claimed
